describe.who: Juno, a 15-year-old girl with tan skin
design: HAIR: short choppy teal hair, with ONE long thin lock hanging down in front of her LEFT ear to her collarbone
GOGGLES: round brass-brown flight goggles with pale teal lenses, always pushed up on her forehead, never over her eyes
HEADPHONES: chunky grey-brown headphones, always resting round her neck on the collar, never on her ears
JACKET: a plain orange cropped flight jacket with a high stand-up collar, worn open, sleeves pushed up to the elbows; the back of the jacket is plain orange

PATCHES: exactly three plain flat one-colour patches on the jacket and nothing else on it: a YELLOW TRIANGLE on the outside of EACH upper sleeve (the same on her left sleeve and on her right sleeve), always with one corner pointing straight up toward the shoulder and a flat base below, and a WHITE CIRCLE on her left chest; each patch is a single flat shape with a black outline and nothing inside it, the same size and in the same place in every drawing
GLOVES: plain grey-brown fingerless gloves on both hands (grey-brown, never teal, never green), bare fingers

TROUSERS: baggy dark-grey cargo trousers with one cream stripe down the outside of each leg and one cargo pocket on the outside of each thigh; gathered cuffs that come down over the tops of the shoes, no bare ankle
SHOES: red high-top trainers with white toe caps, white laces and white soles, completely plain
FACE: plain, no scar, no marks; the same calm look with the mouth closed in every drawing
describe.never: No pins, no badges, no emblems, no insignia, no stars, no lettering, no numbers, no logos and no brand marks anywhere on her.

acting.run: she runs like an athlete, light and fast, fists loose, eyes ahead; her short hair and the open jacket blow back
acting.runtop: an athlete's run; from above her short teal hair with the goggles on her forehead, the orange jacket's shoulders with a yellow triangle patch on each upper sleeve, and her arms and legs are what show
acting.ride: her short hair and the open jacket whip back in the wind; she looks ahead, where she is going; in the first drawing her whole body and the board bank to HER left, in the third to HER right
acting.leap: her hair and jacket fly up; the board stays under her feet in both drawings

board.describe: The GREEN slab with two green lumps under it, beneath her feet in the first image, is her homemade hoverboard: paint it in exactly the slab's place, size and tilt as a flat plank of welded pale steel-grey scrap-metal plates with dark weld lines and a few rivets, with two small pale steel-grey thruster pods underneath, each with one short flat hard-edged cyan-blue flame shape under it. It has NO wheels and no trucks: it floats. Her feet stand on it.
